name: zz-check-mute-state
description: Reads the current emulator user's persisted mute state as rendered in the UI. Run after switch_devvit_user to confirm per-user isolation. Reports the username shown in the lobby plus the mute button's aria-pressed.

steps.expression: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-testid=sound-mute]'); const name = document.querySelector('.lb2-ub-name')?.textContent?.trim() ?? 'n/a'; return JSON.stringify({ user: name, ariaPressed: b?.getAttribute('aria-pressed'), muteLooksActive: !!b && b.className.includes('active'), label: b?.getAttribute('aria-label') }); })()
steps.name: current user + mute state
